copy.curiosityHook: A lucrative overnight payout sounds simple enough, but a night inside a decaying asylum rarely goes according to plan.
copy.description: An amusement park mogul gathers an eclectic group of strangers, promising $1 million each if they can survive the night inside a derelict former mental institution in William Malone's horror remake.
copy.vibeSummary: Suspenseful and engaging horror with a steady pace and moderate emotional weight, built for easy late-night viewing.
copy.whyWatch: At an efficient 93 minutes, it offers an accessible, suspenseful haunted-asylum experience that delivers straightforward genre chills without requiring heavy investment.

allowedMaterial: Premise of mogul offering $1 million to diverse strangers to stay overnight
Setting of decrepit former mental institution
Genre identity as horror remake directed by William Malone
excludedMaterial: Final act twists or behind-the-scenes culprits
